content.comment_body: Hello, I recently purchased a [product_name] kit which includes [product_name] ([product_name] Basic [version_no]). After installing and launching the software, I cannot find an option for PC control or any interface to visualize elements like pipes, valves, or buttons on a PC. I tried to explore all options hoping to locate a 'PC interface', but was unsuccessful. I've seen others demonstrate such an interface online, but it's missing for me. Best regards, [user_name].

To program and monitor your [product_name], you need to use [product_name], which is also included in the kit. The [product_name] is intended for HMI screen development, and the included license restricts usage to HMI programming only. If you want to program devices like PLCs, you will require an additional license, which isn't provided for free.

I'm not very familiar with [product_name], but I might be able to assist. Please check this [url], where you may find useful examples related to [product_name]. Although it's based on an earlier software version, it should still offer helpful guidance.

Hello, be sure to look at the information provided on the right side of the linked page under 'First steps with [product_name]'. There are free training resources especially useful for beginners and focused on [product_name]. Hope you find this useful.
To configure your PC as a runtime device, you need [product_name] Advanced. Starter kits usually only include the Basic version.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking to control and visualize their [product_name] hardware directly through a PC interface using the included software, but cannot locate or activate this feature with the provided Basic version. Respondents clarify that the included license supports only HMI screen development and not comprehensive PC-based runtime control. Additional guidance is given to use [product_name] for programming and recommended online resources for further learning.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the starter kit’s software should enable direct PC-based control and visualization—such as interactive control of pipes, valves, and buttons—of the [product_name], reflecting demonstrations seen online.
